name: Greentown Management Holdings Company Limited
summary: Greentown Management Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides project management services in the People's Republic of China The company offers property development management services for project owners and government. It also provides construction design and consulting services, as well as other services. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, the People's Republic of China. Greentown Management Holdings Company Limited is a subsidiary of Greentown China Holdings Limited.
